messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — Prospect 'NorthPeak' just sent an RFP. Key asks: on‑prem HSM compatibility, a simple acceptance/runbook for POC, and a line‑item pricing matrix for Dedicated vs Private. Need SE + ops to own. Deadline EOD Thu.

lina_se: copying SE triage — I can take technical lead on the runbook/POC plan. Need a quick checklist of what infra they can provide (networking, HSM model, reachable endpoints).

omar_se: got it. Can we confirm whether they want KMS integration (bring‑your‑own) or full HSM via customer HSM appliance? That changes our runbook a lot.

alex_sales: they wrote "HSM on customer side (FIPS 140‑2) + ability to rotate keys via API". Also asked about data residency and audit logs.

lina_se: ok. First pass plan: 1) acceptance criteria, 2) minimal infra diagram, 3) onboarding steps + test prompts, 4) perf tests for throughput/latency, 5) rollback. Quick draft by tomorrow morning.

beth_research: for capability matrix, suggest we call out: model variants supported, quantization/throughput tradeoffs, KV cache behavior, and supported sequence lengths. I'll draft the col headers.

jenna_cs: Customer asked about POC cost estimates — wants a 2‑week POC runbook with estimated units and a cost comparison for Dedicated vs Private. Can Sales own pricing?

alex_sales: yes — but need ops numbers for GPU hours and a rough egress/storage delta from cs.

tim_ops: I can give baseline numbers. For a 2‑week POC (peak 50 concurrent tokens/sec) estimate: Dedicated small pool ~ 320 GPU‑hours, Private (onprem) we estimate infra integration time 3–5 days + no infra fee but ops support band. I'll attach a short calc.

opsbot: attached file: https://files.redwood.internal/attachments/np-poc-costs-1749999000.xlsx (permissions: sales,se,ops)

lina_se: thanks. Also need to answer security questionnaire Q12 about HSM attestation and key lifecycle. Legal + security to comment.

legal_bot: Q12: We support HSM integrations with standard PKCS#11 and can accept attestation reports. For private deployments we recommend customer KMS/HSM in FIPS 140‑2 mode. I'll paste the standard response snippet below for the RFP.

legal_bot: "Redwood supports integration with customer-managed HSMs via PKCS#11 and KMIP. For hosted/private deployments, key material can remain on the customer side; we provide audited connectors and rotation APIs. Attestation and FIPS compliance details available under NDA."

omar_se: to keep POC light, propose a minimal acceptance test set:
- network: TLS + mutual auth verified
- key ops: create, rotate, sign, decrypt using HSM-backed key
- inference correctness: small prompt suite (10 prompts) with baseline outputs saved
- perf: 95th percentile latency under 250ms for 512 tokens

lina_se: nice. Can you paste a tiny sample of the prompt suite and the curl flow for key ops? I'll wire into the runbook.

omar_se: sample prompt suite: ["summarize meeting notes", "extract PII", "rerank 5 items by relevance"].
Sample key ops (pseudo):
```
# create key
curl -X POST https://customer-hsm.example.com/v1/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"type":"aes-gcm-256"}'

# sign test
curl -X POST https://redwood.internal/api/v1/kms/sign -H "X-Key-Id: <key>" -d '{"payload":"test"}'
```

alex_sales: Build timeline: tomorrow AM runbook draft, Thu morning pricing matrix, Thu EOD submit RFP. Who can take owner for final assembly?

lina_se: I'll own runbook + acceptance tests.

tim_ops: I'll own cost calc + infra notes.

beth_research: I'll assemble capability matrix and short copy for each row (what we support vs limitations).

jenna_cs: I'll own the response doc upload and make sure attachments are tagged in the portal.

legal_bot: I'll queue the security Qs for review; expect comments in ~48h (may slow the EOD cutoff).

alex_sales: flagged risk — if legal delays more than 48h we miss the RFP window. Options: sign NDA fast or give provisional answer w/ followup.

lina_se: provisional answer sounds OK: mark any compliance claims as "subject to attestation and NDA". We'll include the runbook and test logs to show feasibility.

opsbot: checklist created: https://tasks.redwood.internal/np-poc-checklist/1749999000 (items: runbook draft, cost sheet, capability matrix, security answers, attachments upload).

omar_se: small note — we should include an ops contact for oncall during POC. I'll be primary, tim secondary.

alex_sales: perfect. I'll send an intro email to NorthPeak with the plan after runbook draft. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

jenna_cs: adding calendar block for kickoff Fri 09:00 and POC sprint board.

beth_research: attaching capability snapshot (inline):
```
columns: [Feature, Hosted, Dedicated, Private, Notes]
row1: [HSM integration, limited (via connector), supported, supported, Private supports BYO HSM PKCS#11]
row2: [Quantization, recommended q4_8/gptq, supported, supported, perf varies by GPU family]
row3: [KV cache persistence, in-memory (stateless), persistent-optional, persistent-optional, Private can enable persistent KV store]
```

alex_sales: awesome — please all comment on the runbook PR when ready. I'll block any legal/exec escalations if needed.

lina_se: will do.

(END)
